title: The finite constant inverse-image comparison is the native constant comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, schemes X and Y and f:X -> Y, ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] has the same hom as leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat A) f (ModuleCat.of A A): the exact left-derived pullback of the constant A sheaf in degree zero followed by the sheaf-level constant inverse-image comparison.

proof.text: Compose ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_hom with finiteConstantComparison_hom by transitivity. The intermediate expression is the exact same single-degree comparison followed by the sheaf-level constant comparison.

proof_origin.place: Proved constant-unit normalization used in the first-coordinate tail.

from.place: The constant-object unit normalization in the first triangle.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic identity preservation supplies the elementary normalization.

mathlib_searches.results: Nine hits for constantSheafAdj counits and condensed discrete constants; no native derived single-degree comparison formula.

lean.statement:
theorem unitPullback_native_hom
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f
        (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
